_comment_en: Model/pricing catalog consumed by mova.local/budget (EstimateCost) and mova.local/trace (context-trace's MODEL COMPATIBILITY table). All input/output prices are THEORETICAL / ESTIMATED and exclude output tokens, tool calls, caching, and other provider-specific charges - see reports' own disclaimer line. context_window is in tokens; 0 means 'not configured / provider-dependent', rendered as '-' and never guessed. Entries marked local:true (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) always cost $0 in EstimateCost regardless of the input/output numbers present here - see budget/estimate_helpers.go.
_comment_es: Catalogo de modelos y precios que consume mova.local/budget (EstimateCost) y mova.local/trace (tabla MODEL COMPATIBILITY de context-trace). Todos los precios de entrada/salida son TEORICOS / ESTIMADOS y excluyen tokens de salida, tool calls, cache y otros cargos propios de cada proveedor. context_window esta en tokens; 0 significa 'no configurado / depende del proveedor', se muestra como '-' y nunca se adivina. Las entradas marcadas local:true (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) siempre cuestan $0 en EstimateCost sin importar los numeros de input/output presentes aqui.

claude-sonnet._comment_en: Uncertain: Anthropic does not publish one single universal context window across all Claude Sonnet deployments - actual limit depends on the specific model version and provider configuration. context_window left at 0 (shown as '-') on purpose; do not treat this as 'no limit'.

claude-haiku._comment_en: Same uncertainty note as claude-sonnet above.

ollama._comment_en: Local inference (Ollama). API Cost is always $0 - see local:true. context_window depends entirely on which model the person has pulled locally, so it is left at 0 ('-') rather than guessed.
